Jon (Support): FYI @Maya - trial tenant 'astra-insights' hitting auth failures and webhook timeouts. 3 seats, trial ends in 6 days. opened ticket #80221 :rotating_light:
Maya (CS): thanks Jon. can you paste the most recent error and confirm the customer contact? we'll spin up a priority handoff :eyes:
Jon (Support): latest from logs:
```
2025-02-11T09:18:42Z ERROR AuthService: 401 Unauthorized - refresh token invalid (tenant: astra-insights)
2025-02-11T09:19:05Z WARN WebhookDelivery: 504 Gateway Timeout -> retried 4 times
Trace: trace-8f4e2a
```
Contact: emilia@astra.com (Product Ops). They've attempted SSO and token regen twice. ops-bot: traces/dash -> https://internal.redwood/logs/80221 and perf spike -> https://dash.redwood/tenant/astra/80221
Maya (CS): triage proposal: 1) 15m sync with Emilia today to confirm consent + scope. 2) hands-on enablement session tomorrow to walk through token regen + webhook backfill. 3) short-term mitigation: disable webhook retries and enable manual backfill job. If backfill fails, escalate to eng-oncall. Who can join the enablement? :calendar:
Taylor (Solutions): I can lead the enablement at 10:30am PT tomorrow. I'll prep curl/Postman snippets and a rollback plan.
Priya (Onboarding): I'll update the runbook snippet (permissions + least-privilege steps) and note onboarding pitfalls we saw earlier.
Jon (Support): Emilia is available 4pm PT today for a 15m sync. I'll start the token regen after consent and send creds via vault link.
eng-oncall: acknowledged - if manual backfill fails, ping me and include the trace link.
Maya (CS): action items: 1) Maya -> send warm intro to Emilia + invite for 4pm PT 2) Taylor -> enablement at 10:30am PT tomorrow 3) Priya -> runbook updates 4) Jon -> regen token after sync and share secure link. Follow-up: renewal health update by EOD Friday. tagging owners: @Taylor / @Priya / @Jon / @eng-oncall. Closing loop unless new info :thumbsup:
